title: Recent Progress for Single-Molecule Magnets Based on Rare Earth Elements
claim: Approximate D4d coordination in [LnW10O36]9- does not reproduce the SMM behavior of [LnPc2]-.
explanation: AlDamen's [LnW10O36]9- (Ln = Tb, Dy, Ho, Er) and the related [Ln(β2-SiW11O39)2]13- series place Ln in an approximately D4d ligand field, but the review explicitly says the behavior differs completely from [LnPc2]-. [ErW10O36]9- is identified as the first Er heteropolyacid SMM.
scope: Lindqvist-type and related Keggin-derived Ln polyoxometalates versus double-decker Ln phthalocyanines.
caveats: The review does not specify which relaxation parameters differ, only that the SMM behavior is completely different.
